newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: REDECO TO SET UP CIGARETTE COMPANY.
newsitem.headline: REDECO TO SET UP CIGARETTE COMPANY.

text.p: Republic Resources and Development Co (Redeco) said it had signed an agreement with Hong Kong-based Lucky Seven Overseas Co to form a cigarette making company in the Philippines.

Redeco president Sherwin Gatchalian told reporters after a stockholders' meeting late on Tuesday that Redeco would hold a 60 percent stake in the new venture while Lucky Seven would hold the remaining 40 percent.
Seventy percent of the company's output will be for export and the rest will be sold locally.
Gatchalian said the cigarette venture would help boost Redeco's profits for 1998. Redeco forecast 1998 net profit would rise to 1.039 billion pesos from a projected 364.79 million pesos this year.
Gatchalian said stockholders had approved the change in the company's name to Wellex Industries as well as the firm's purpose from a property concern to a manufacturing firm.
Redeco has also started talks with food companies for a possible buy-in. Gatchalian declined to elaborate.
